parties: W.K. Abeyratna v. Gangabodage Somapala and Others W.K. Abeyratna v. Gangabodage Somapala and Others View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court order accepting an alternative partition plan instead of the Commissioner’s final plan. Held - Appeal allowed with costs as original final plan had been prepared in accordance with the interlocutory decree, proportionate shares and existing buildings and plantations, while the alternative plan had been introduced much later.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
